reason: already_serving(port) returns True for ANY running board, not one serving this repo: it only checks that /api/state has a root, never that the root matches. So a board open on another checkout makes 'forge board' print 'already running' and open someone else's board, and makes 'forge next' claim a board is up for a repo that has none. It also makes test_gates non-hermetic — the suite fails on a developer machine purely because a board happens to be running.
